extraction: Summary fields only; raw samples, per-frame records, maxima and telemetry omitted. Historical status fields retained verbatim.

data.status: Model inference is below 10 ms; actual NVDEC-to-GPU-output still exceeds 10 ms. Viewer presentation remains unintegrated. Goal remains active.
data.scope: Same trained EDSR architecture/checkpoint, 720p input and x2 output. No retraining. Changes residual activation precision and storage on 14 boundaries.
data.coding: Keep existing INT8 codes q; encode round_even((FP16_state*factor-q)*14) in -7..7 as byte code 0..14. Code 15 reads an original FP16 escape when abs(state*factor-q)>0.5. Only escape locations are read/written in the dense FP16 allocation. Decode FP16((q+(code-7)/14)*(1/factor)).
data.layout: Correction codes are one byte each in CHW32. Physical four-bit packing was slower; it is not used in this candidate.
data.quality_gate: 72 frozen Mac development frames, yuv420p 720p / 600 Kbps. Mean PSNR loss <=0.05 dB and worst-frame loss <=0.10 dB against BOTH FP32 and original AMP. No test-set selection; passing does not establish OCR/readability equivalence.

latency.model_scope: Resident RGB720 -> RGB1440, including same D2D input/output copies as prior model benchmark.
latency.decode_scope: Compressed packet submit -> NVDEC/color -> GPU preprocessing -> EDSR -> GPU RGBA1080 -> consumer stream completion. First frozen clip replayed; not 1000 independent clips. Excludes network, demux, pacing, presentation and encoding.

memory.note: This reduces traffic, not capacity: retaining a dense masked FP16 escape allocation increases reserved engine memory.

sanitizer.limitation: Default full-engine CUDA API diagnostics remain unresolved; do not claim the full engine is sanitizer-clean. Initial nibble harness had four API diagnostics at torch bool inversion; equivalent equality check avoids that helper and final kernel check reports zero errors.

limitations: CUDA trace does not measure NVDEC hardware occupancy or all internal driver transfers.
Use the detached benchmark for speed claims.
Final event synchronization belongs to the serial-latency measurement harness; the runtime submit/handoff uses GPU event ordering.

native_tactics.first_byte_candidate: 15 native INT8 convolutions chose tile64x128, tactic 0x214f03e23f252333.
native_tactics.final_candidate: A fresh editable-cache build automatically chose tile64x256, tactic 0x9dafb2758560cc1d, on all 15 layers. No manual cache replacement was needed.

preserved_failures: Initial corner reference used FP16 overflow; finite 60000 values fixed the test without relaxing equality.
One quality launch was refused by the GPU occupancy guard while build was still running; successful measurement ran afterward.
next_work: Investigate the remaining decoder/color and GPU preprocessing overhead without introducing CPU pixel transfers.
Retest full quality and actual GPU decoder path for any new faster candidate; retain the hashed engine and timing cache.
GPU surface runtime is implemented; viewer GPU texture presentation is not integrated or measured.
